criteria.text: Running `pdd --version` from the approved checkout or branch build prints the package version with a `-dev.<branch>.<sha>` suffix, such as `0.1.9-dev.feature-2455-bd781e7d.5a45a2c8b`, followed by one newline and no package-name prefix.
Running `pdd --version` from the published release continues to print only the release version, such as `0.1.9`, followed by one newline.
